title: A shared foundation with fair proportions

captions.emotions: Feeling the conclusion has fair proportions

meaning: You can build a consistent shared view when a clear foundation is accompanied by a sense of appropriate proportion in your conclusions.
text: Understanding something together becomes easier when the route from question to conclusion is visible. The Emperor in the physical position of Ajna suggests a stepwise examination: what is known, which conditions matter and what follows from them. The Emperor in energy supports the wish for a clear coherent foundation. The same card has different roles, the order of your actions and the motive of seeking a dependable structure. Justice in emotions responds with proportion when an explanation fits its material.

For example, you compare two ways of organising a small shared library. First you decide what needs to be found quickly, then test each option through the same examples. **A clear foundation makes comparison fair and understandable to both of you.** You can see which arrangement suits the present task while preserving the other option’s merits. The choice gains an explanation without declaring one approach universally correct. Jointly selected conditions make the examination repeatable beyond the persuasiveness of personal preferences.

The difficulty is refining conditions until the comparison becomes flawless for every imaginable case. Seeking a clear foundation stays constructive while discussion can lose its scale. A sense of fairness helps when it includes whether the material is sufficient. A conclusion can suit your current library while leaving future experience free to pose another question with fresh grounds for comparison.
